notes:
Passed on the fake backend only by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); no hardware was attached and no human reviewed or tested the package. G1-G5, G7 and G9 pass. The only warnings are the expected bridge-derived ones: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge stores the pending seed and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT (ticks, action.values[*] and seed in reset and seed). There are no G4 REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. No catalogue extension id was used, so there are no catalogue requests. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD (mock path only): mock_strategy.preferred is upstream-sim, but the clone is never imported or run and the upstream needs Taichi, the legacy gym package, numpy and a GPU, so the fake backend is the package's own pure-Python stand-in. The card's env id is a template built at run time (plb/envs/__init__.py:6-13); a GymnasiumDriver serves one concrete environment, so this package serves Move-v1, the README usage example (README.md:6), and the other 49 registered ids are not served. The sim backend (gymnasium.make through the legacy gym registration) was not run. NOT COVERED: the MPM soft-body solver, contacts, friction, gravity, yield stress, loss/reward/inverse-IoU, rendering and snapshot/restore are not modelled. The fake returns the real Move-v1 observation length (1214 = 200 x 6 + 2 x 7) but its particle values are placeholders, the reward is always 0.0 and info is empty; it models the two primitive kinematic positions and the 50-step TimeLimit of the registration. The reset seed and options are accepted by the bridge but ignored, matching PlasticineEnv.reset() (plb/envs/env.py:28); the fidelity says determinism seeded with seed_control none. timestep_ms is the 2 ms environment step (40 physics substeps of 0.05 ms), disclosed in the facts and fidelity gaps. The upstream clone has no licence file, so the card's NOASSERTION/unknown licence is pinned unchanged; that recon is unresolved, not declared compatible. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by the gate and is not part of the package.
